active.title: Portfolio proof-to-artifact conversion
active.problem: R&D can generate strong internal research while too little of it becomes a human-inspectable, evidence-backed portfolio artifact that an owner, buyer, or operator can actually judge.
active.hypothesis: Making portfolio conversion the highest-priority research question, choosing one material proof gap per day, and coupling that gap to bounded Senju technical improvement will increase the rate at which BUILDING outputs become genuinely VERIFIED without increasing reporting noise.
active.commercial_bridge: The portfolio exists to turn verified R&D output into something a human can inspect, understand, evaluate, sell, or reuse. Senju technical evidence may strengthen proof quality but must not be treated as willingness-to-pay, market validation, contract value, payment, or revenue.

active.title: Seed-robust Senju champion selection
active.problem: A strategy can look strong in one tournament yet fail multi-seed stability, slowing safe autonomous promotion.
active.hypothesis: A bounded multi-candidate league plus unseen holdout selection will produce more stable champions than single-candidate promotion.
active.commercial_bridge: If repeatedly verified, package the stability and quality-control method as evidence of reliable AI operations. Technical evidence alone does not establish buyer demand.
